title: Connected Hotbar Forked
body:
Fork of [**Connected Hotbar**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/connected-hotbar) for 1.21.11

Removes the dividers between slots in the hotbar making it one big seamless box. Also, the background color of the hotbar has been slightly changed
